topic: Male and Female Reproductive System Parts and Functions
key_concepts: Reproduction ensures the continued existence of living organisms.
The male reproductive system produces sperm cells and male hormones.
The testes are oval-shaped organs in the scrotum that produce sperm cells and testosterone
The scrotum is a sac-like skin that protects the testes.
The epididymis connects the testes to the vas deferens and is where sperm cells mature.
The vas deferens carries mature sperm cells to the urethra.
The penis transfers sperm cells into the vagina.
The female reproductive system produces egg cells and female hormones.
The ovaries produce mature egg cells and release estrogen and progesterone.
The fallopian tubes connect the ovaries to the uterus and carry egg cells.
The uterus holds and nourishes the fertilized egg until the baby is fully developed.
The cervix expands during birth to allow the baby to pass through.
